newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER SHOWCASE-REAL MADRID DRAW WITH REAL BETIS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER SHOWCASE-REAL MADRID DRAW WITH REAL BETIS.

text.p: Result in the Spanish league championship on Saturday: Real Madrid 2 Real Betis 2 (halftime 1-1)
Scorers: Real Madrid: Predrag Mijatovic 20, Christian Panucci 52 Real Betis: Alfonso Perez 7, Finidi George 60

Real Madrid: 25-Bodo Illgner, 17-Christian Panucci, 4-Fernando Hierro, 18-Rafael Alkorta, 3-Roberto Carlos 11-Emilio Amavisca (14-Luis Milla 79th minute), 6-Fernando Redondo, 10-Clarence Seedorf, 7-Raul Gonzalez 8-Predrag Mijatovic, 9-Davor Suker

Real Betis: 13-Toni Prats, 14-Roberto Rios, 21-Hristo Vidakovic, 20-Tomas Olias, 25-Finidi George (15-Pier Cherubino), 6-Juan Merino, 2-Jaime Quesada, 7-Alexis Trujillo, 17-Robert Jarni, 16-Wojciech Kowalczyk (5-Josete Valdomino), 11-Alfonso Perez.
